def transform(grid):

    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps = components(grid)

    ls=[]
    for color,cells in comps:

        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        top,bottom,left,right=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        hh,ww=bottom-top+1,right-left+1; s=set(cells)
        if len(cells)!=hh+ww-1: continue
        arms=(all((top,c) in s for c in range(left,right+1)) and all((r,right) in s for r in range(top,bottom+1))) or \
             (all((top,c) in s for c in range(left,right+1)) and all((r,left) in s for r in range(top,bottom+1))) or \
             (all((bottom,c) in s for c in range(left,right+1)) and all((r,right) in s for r in range(top,bottom+1))) or \
             (all((bottom,c) in s for c in range(left,right+1)) and all((r,left) in s for r in range(top,bottom+1)))
        if arms: ls.append((len(cells),color,hh,ww,cells))
    if not ls: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,paint,lh,lw,lcells=max(ls)
    marker=lcells
    lr=[r for r,c in marker]; lc=[c for r,c in marker]
    top,bottom,left,right=min(lr),max(lr),min(lc),max(lc)
    ms=set(marker)
    corners=[(r,c) for r,c in marker if sum((r+dr,c+dc) in ms for dr,dc in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)))==2]
    corner=corners[0] if corners else (top,left)
    cr,cc=corner
    # Select the nearest object in the open rectangular quadrant of the L.
    vert_up=all((r,cc) in ms for r in range(top,cr+1))
    vert_down=all((r,cc) in ms for r in range(cr,bottom+1))
    horiz_left=all((cr,c) in ms for c in range(left,cc+1))
    horiz_right=all((cr,c) in ms for c in range(cc,right+1))
    def inside(r,c):
        return ((r>cr and c>cc) if vert_down and horiz_right else
                (r<cr and c<cc) if vert_up and horiz_left else
                (r>cr and c<cc) if vert_down and horiz_left else
                (r<cr and c>cc))
    candidates=[(color,cells) for color,cells in comps if color not in (bg,paint) and any(inside(r,c) for r,c in cells)]
    if not candidates: candidates=[(color,cells) for color,cells in comps if color not in (bg,paint)]
    if not candidates: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    def distance(cells): return min(abs(r-y)+abs(c-x) for r,c in cells for y,x in marker)
